name: Buer
source:
He was affiliated to Mammon's bloc, but he went under Lucifer after making a contract with the dog god.

He is the devil who is rumored to have the most secrets in Hell, and refuses even now to take off his uniform from Mammon's bloc and wear the uniform from Paradise Lost.
